description: Compare FMCSA-registered ELD providers on monthly price per truck, contract length, hardware cost, three-year total cost of ownership and hidden fees. Optionally filter to a specific provider and size the cost to a fleet.

provider.description: Optional provider name to focus on, e.g. 'Motive' or 'Samsara'. Null returns all providers.

trucks.description: Optional fleet size used to compute annual software cost per provider. Null omits it.

name: compare_eld_providers
title: Compare ELD providers
